title: Prisma 7 with @prisma/adapter-pg fails with P1010 or a certificate error on a database that worked with Prisma 6
symptoms: P1010: User was denied access on the database
Error: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
cause: Prisma 7 connects through node-postgres instead of the Rust engine, and node-postgres verifies server certificates by default. sslmode=require in the URL also means full verification there and overrides any ssl object passed alongside it.
fix: Remove sslmode from the URL and give the adapter the provider's CA certificate. Turning verification off with rejectUnauthorized false works but skips the identity check.
